transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. I'm Dr. [Name]. What brings you in today?

I'm... just really tired. Um. Not the usual kind of tired you get from teaching all day. It's more like... even if I sleep all night, I just... I have to force myself to get through grading papers, making dinner, getting ready for the next day. It just doesn't go away.
Have you noticed that you don't enjoy things as much as you used to, even activities you normally like?

I suppose so. Um... most days I can still, you know, smile for the kids and get through the lessons. But... underneath that, it's just... this gray, flat feeling. It sort of follows me home. Even things I used to like... my garden, or my watercolors... they just seem really far away now. I just don't have the energy for them.
Can you tell me if you’ve lost interest in things you used to enjoy, like your garden or painting?
Um... yeah. Like I just said... I don't really do them anymore. I just don't have the energy for it right now.
Have you been feeling down or depressed most of the day, nearly every day, for at least the past two weeks?

Um... yes. I mean, like I was just saying... I can get through the lessons and smile for my students, but... yeah. That flat, gray feeling is just always there underneath. It follows me home every day. And... it's been going on for a lot longer than two weeks.
Have you been feeling worthless or guilty about things, even when there’s no real reason to feel that way?

I suppose... yes. Um... I just feel like I should be handling everything better. Like... my lesson plans take me twice as long now, and... I had to say no to mentoring a newer teacher recently. I just... I feel like I'm letting my family down, and... my school, too.
Have you had episodes of feeling this way before, where you felt down, lost interest in things, and had trouble getting through your day?
I don't know. I mean... it's just kind of always been this way. I don't really remember a time when I didn't feel like this. It's not really episodes, it's just... how things are.
Have you been feeling this way — down, tired, and losing interest in things — for most of the time over the past two years?

Yes... um, I suppose so. It's been... maybe two years and a couple of months. Just... since my husband stopped working outside the home. Our household routine changed a lot then, and... yeah. It's been since about then.
